headline: Hearing and consideration of an entertainment per diem license petition for Segue IFL at 325 Cowden Street.
summary: The meeting will hold a hearing and consider a petition for an entertainment per diem license. The applicant is Nadya Sanchez for Segue IFL at 325 Cowden Street.
